questions.question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 
 

 15
 81
 12
 
 

 18
 99
 15
 
 

 17
 120
 ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

**Row-wise Operation: (First number + Third number) × (First number - Third number) = Second number**

Row 1 :- 

 
 

 15
 81
 12
 
 

⇒ (15 + 12) × (15 - 12)

⇒ 27 × 3

⇒ 81

Row 2 :-

 
 

 18
 99
 15
 
 

⇒ (18 + 15) × (18 - 15)

⇒ 33 × 3

⇒ 99

Row 3 :-

 
 

 17
 120
 ?
 
 

Consider, ? = x

⇒ 120 = (17 + x) × (17 - x)

⇒ 120 = 17² - x²

⇒ x² = 289 - 120

⇒ x² = 169

**⇒ x = 13**

Hence, the correct answer is **"13".**

questions.question: Five friends, H, I, J, K and L, are top rank holders of a school. The rank of H is just above the rank of K and just below the rank of L. I is at the top rank and J is not at the lowest rank. Who among them is at the lowest rank?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

Five friends, H, I, J, K and L, are top rank holders of a school.

1) The rank of H is just above the rank of K and just below the rank of L.

L > H > K

2) I is at the top rank and J is not at the lowest rank.

I > J > L > H > K.

∴ Here, from the given 'K' is the lowest rank holder of a school.

Hence, the correct answer is **"K".**

questions.question: In a class of 95 students, all play at least one of the three games — snooker, chess and tennis. 42 students play snooker, 49 play tennis, and 43 play chess. The total number of students who play any and only two games is 29. The 5 students play all the three games. The number of students who play only snooker and only chess is equal. 11 students play only snooker and tennis. 6 students play only snooker and chess. How many students play only tennis?
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given information is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a03d04f46e4687acdde0ef79361688cd6846b7bed02cc6dfe1adb647474fa06.png] 

The total number of students in a class = **95 students.**

⇒ Number of students play snooker = 42

⇒ Number of students play tennis = 49

⇒ Number of students play chess = 43

⇒ Number of students who play all three games = 5

**GIven:**

__
 
• The total number of students who play any and **only two games = 29.**

⇒ Number of students play only snooker and tennis = 11

⇒ Number of students play only snooker and chess = 6

∴ Number of students play only tennis and chess = Total number of students who play any and only two games - (Number of students play only snooker and tennis + Number of students play only snooker and chess)

⇒ Number of students play only tennis and chess = 29 - (11 + 6)

⇒ Number of students play only tennis and chess = 29 - 17

**→ Number of students play only tennis and chess = 12**

⇒ **Number of students who play only snooker = Number of students play snooker - (Number of students who play all three games + Number of students play only snooker and tennis + Number of students play only snooker and chess)**

⇒ Number of students who play only snooker = 42 - (5 + 11 + 6)

⇒ Number of students who play only snooker = 42 - 22

⇒ Number of students who play only snooker = 20

⇒ The number of students who play only snooker and only chess is equal = 20

⇒ Number of students who play only tennis = Number of students play tennis - (Number of students who play all three games + Number of students play only tennis and chess + Number of students play only snooker and tennis)

⇒ Number of students who play only tennis = 49 - (5 + 12 + 11)

⇒ Number of students who play only tennis = 49 - 28

⇒ **Number of students who play only tennis = 21**

Hence, the correct answer is **"21".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] Alternate Method__**

The best approach could be to go by forming the diagram in parallel to reading this question,

Total students = 95

Students playing snooker = 42

Students playing chess = 43

Students playing tennis = 49

Total number of students who play any and only two games = 29

Students playing all the 3 games = 5

Students play only snooker and tennis = 11

Students play only snooker and chess = 6

Number of students who play only snooker and only chess is equal.

On forming diagram,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a11d747d402372e183dd49eb372202154eed712d8c7a8e675b704b61f4548ed.png] 

Since, number of students who play any and only two games = 29 

∴ 11 + 6 + x = 29

⇒ x = 12 (Number of students playing only tennis and chess)

Now, Number of students who play only tennis = 49 - (11 + 5 + 12)

⇒ 49 - 28

⇒ 21

questions.question:
Which two signs need to be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

72 × 18 ÷ 9 + 19 − 39 = 16
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aacb9b5c9c0e66a9d27b184ff5f4793344022e762e948f5afcad76a2b1508286.png] 

Option 1) : − and ×

Given equation : 72 × 18 ÷ 9 + 19 − 39 = 16

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 72 - 18 ÷ 9 + 19 × 39 = 16

⇒ 72 - __**18 ÷ 9**__ + 19 × 39 = 16

⇒ 72 - 2 + __**19 × 39**__ = 16

⇒ __**72**__ - 2 __**+ 741**__ = 16

⇒ __**813 - 2**__ = 16

⇒ 811 ≠ 16

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : + and ×

Given equation : 72 × 18 ÷ 9 + 19 − 39 = 16

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 72 + 18 ÷ 9 × 19 - 39 = 16

⇒ 72 + __**18 ÷ 9**__ × 19 - 39 = 16

⇒ 72 + __**2 × 19**__ - 39 = 16

⇒ __**72 + 38**__ - 39 = 16

⇒ __**110 - 39**__ = 16

⇒ 71 ≠ 16

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : − and +

Given equation : 72 × 18 ÷ 9 + 19 − 39 = 16

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 72 × 18 ÷ 9 - 19 + 39 = 16

⇒ 72 × __**18 ÷ 9**__ - 19 + 39 = 16

⇒ __**72 × 2**__ - 19 + 39 = 16

⇒ __**144**__ - 19 __**+ 39**__ = 16

⇒ __**183 - 19**__ = 16

⇒ 164 ≠ 16

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) : ÷ and ×

Given equation : 72 × 18 ÷ 9 + 19 − 39 = 16

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 72 ÷ 18 × 9 + 19 - 39 = 16

⇒ __**72 ÷ 18**__ × 9 + 19 - 39 = 16

⇒ __**4 × 9**__ + 19 - 39 = 16

⇒ __**36 + 19**__ - 39 = 16

⇒ __**55 - 39**__ = 16

⇒ **16 = 16**

**LHS = RHS**

Hence, the correct answer is **"÷ and ×".**

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

28 + 14 × 7 ÷ 5 – 18 = 20
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc029b549c59f7f5debf9f398b3841c649d8de85dba8131c7c638212401bba8d.png] 

Option 1) : ÷ and +

Given equation is : 28 + 14 × 7 ÷ 5 – 18 = 20

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 28 ÷ 14 × 7 + 5 - 18 = 20

⇒ __**28 ÷ 14**__ × 7 + 5 - 18 = 20

⇒ __**2 × 7**__ + 5 - 18 = 20

⇒ __**14 + 5**__ - 18 = 20

⇒ __**19 - 18**__ = 20

⇒ 1 ≠ 20

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : ÷ and –

Given equation is : 28 + 14 × 7 ÷ 5 – 18 = 20

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 28 + 14 × 7 - 5 ÷ 18 = 20

⇒ 28 + 14 × 7 - __**5 ÷ 18**__ = 20

⇒ 28 + __**14 × 7**__ - 0.277 = 20

⇒ __**28 + 98**__ - 0.277 = 20

⇒ __**126 - 0.277**__ = 20

⇒ 125.722 ≠ 20

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : ÷ and ×

Given equation is : 28 + 14 × 7 ÷ 5 – 18 = 20

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 28 + 14 ÷ 7 × 5 - 18 = 20

⇒ 28 + __**14 ÷ 7**__ × 5 - 18 = 20

⇒ 28 + __**2 × 5**__ - 18 = 20

⇒ __**28 + 10**__ - 18 = 20

⇒ __**38 - 18**__ = 20

⇒ **20 = 20**

**LHS = RHS**

Option 4) : + and ×

Given equation is : 28 + 14 × 7 ÷ 5 – 18 = 20

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 28 × 14 + 7 ÷ 5 - 18 = 20

⇒ 28 × 14 + __**7 ÷ 5**__ - 18 = 20

⇒ __**28 × 14**__ + 1.4 - 18 = 20

⇒ __**392 + 1.4**__ - 18 = 20

⇒ __**393.4 - 18**__ = 20

⇒ 375.4 ≠ 20

LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is **"÷ and ×".**
